fields.description: The marketplace as billed in ERPNext (the debtor, e.g. Myntra Jabong Pvt. Ltd.). Its Sales Orders carry the marketplace PO number.
fields.label: Billing Customer

fields.description: The primary sale is a normal sale (Delivery Note and Sales Invoice); these ledgers only carry the price variance of the secondary sales.
fields.label: Ledgers

fields.description: Liability. Credited at import with the variance of secondary sales below the primary rate (OR Sales Variance Dr / OR Sale Provision Cr); cleared by the month-end Credit Note (OR Sale Provision Dr / Billing Customer Cr).
fields.label: OR Sale Provision Account

fields.description: Expense. Debited with the provision for sales below the primary rate; credited by the month-end Debit Note for sales above it.
fields.label: OR Sales Variance Account
